prompt:

Image 2 is the immediately previous discovery frame09; it anchors the immediately preceding location and visual continuity.
Shot title: Only luminous water ripples remain.
Required camera event: Complete the upward camera movement from the previous surface-rise frame. The entire image now shows ONLY SHIMMERING RIPPLING WATER viewed from just below / at the surface. Maintain the same freshwater color and the same long soft sunlike aquarium-light reflection from the previous frame. Luminous silver, pale cyan and gentle green reflections ripple across the whole 2:1 frame, with a long soft bright light strip broken naturally by moving water. Bright airy photographic ending, softly radiant yet realistic. The ocean-like feeling comes ONLY from the shimmering ripple patterns, not from an ocean scene. Absolutely NO plants, leaves, fish, shrimp, wood, rock, sand, animals, glass frame, room, sky, horizon, coast, visible light fixture, UI, lettering or logos. No dark navy field. This must be a new upward-looking water-surface viewpoint, not an underwater plant photograph cropped or blurred.

The camera can turn, lower, lift and pass behind objects to discover new details, with genuine depth-dependent parallax and revealed occlusion. Do not merely digitally zoom/crop the previous photo, and do not rearrange the environment or introduce an unrelated aquarium. Preserve natural materials, green/cyan color balance, clear water and upper-left daylight. Natural 55mm photographic perspective with close focusing where needed; actual new camera viewpoint. Changes should follow smoothly from the previous frame while making the reveal unmistakable. The original master anchors the world, NOT a requirement to repeat its wide composition in every frame.
Rendering: premium photorealistic underwater photography, believable transparent water/refraction, real plant/animal detail, restrained bokeh, no painted or game-render look. No text, UI, logo, watermark, labels, borders or collage. No room, tank rim or ocean/coral/horizon. Add only the single subject specifically authorized for this shot; all other animals/equipment stay out of view. Preserve original assets; generate only this new frame.
Final user clarification: the long sunlike glittering LIGHT STREAK runs INTO DEPTH toward the camera, from the upper part of the frame toward the lower foreground (top-to-bottom or a gentle diagonal), sparkling and breaking across the ripples. Do not make it merely a horizontal light bar. Only water and its luminous reflected streak, no actual outdoor sun, sky or horizon.
